title: University of Bradford Scholarships (International)

The 60th Anniversary Scholarship

For 2026/27 entry, the University of Bradford lists a 60th Anniversary Scholarship as a tuition fee discount for self-funded international students. The amount depends on your nationality. For Nepal, the listed amount is £3,200 per year, compared with £2,200 for students from many other countries.

⚠️
Check 2027 entryThe figures above come from the university's 2026/27 page. Scholarship amounts can change, so confirm the amount for your intake before you apply.

Who Is Eligible?

  • Self-funded international students: students funded by a government or sponsor are not covered.
  • New students: including those progressing from the pre-masters program.
  • Full-time, on-campus postgraduate taught courses: undergraduate and online courses are not included.
  • Not on discounted partnership programs: these are excluded.

How the Scholarship Works

The university states that no separate application is needed. The discount is applied automatically when you enroll, so make sure you hold a confirmed offer for an eligible course.

A tuition discount reduces what you pay each year, but it does not replace your maintenance funds. For a UK Student visa you still need to show living costs: £1,171 per month outside London now, rising to £1,203 from 30 November 2026, for up to nine months.

Other Ways to Reduce Your Costs

  • Other Bradford awards: the university lists additional scholarships for different groups.
  • GREAT Scholarships: British Council scholarships exist for selected countries; check whether your country is eligible.
  • Part-time work: up to 20 hours a week in term time under Student visa rules.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to apply separately for the Bradford scholarship?
No. The university states the discount is applied automatically at enrollment for eligible students.
Is the scholarship paid in cash?
It is a tuition fee discount, not a cash payment to you.
Can undergraduates get this scholarship?
The listed 60th Anniversary Scholarship is for full-time postgraduate taught courses. Undergraduates should check other awards.
